content:
omar: Quick sync — scheduling an A/B + partial canary for v3-quant-lite tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Short summary: solid p95 latency improvement but small MRR drop concentrated in long-docs. Need to lock auto-fallback rules and slice-weight gating.

leah: Please paste the key numbers and proposed rules.

omar: From the smoke run: baseline(v2p9) mrr=0.398, p95=240ms, halluc=0.009; candidate mrr=0.388 (-2.5%), p95=190ms (-50ms), halluc=0.012 (+0.3% abs). Long-doc slice shows -6.2% (sample ~2.1k).

ben: Window size? how do we measure slice contribution?

sophia: Proposal: run 10% A/B stable + 10% canary phased by slice (long-doc cap 5% initially). Use 10m rolling windows evaluated every 5m. Compute delta_contrib = slice_frac * slice_rel_drop; trigger slice-hold if delta_contrib >= 0.25 * global_rel_drop. Require 2 consecutive soft windows to enter slice-hold, 3 consecutive hard windows to full rollback.

infra-bot: Draft rollout config can express this. Example: rollout phases (ab 10%, ramp 20%), metrics: mrr hard 3% rollback, soft 1% throttle, hallucination hard 0.006 rollback. slice_rules: formula delta_contrib = slice_frac * slice_rel_drop, trigger_fraction 0.25 -> action slice_hold+targeted_warmup. Windows: eval_interval 5m, require_consecutive_hard 3, soft 2.

leah: Add exclusions: remove single-turn cold sessions (<3 tokens) from MRR signals. Use unbiased per-slice scoring for weighting. Also capture kv_hit_rate and kv_warmup_time in telemetry.

omar: Agreed. Operational idea: when slice-hold triggers, reduce candidate to 5% for that slice, start a warmed shadow run for 24h focused on long-doc traffic and run 10k warmed long-doc offline evals before considering global rollback.

sophia: I'll add a warmed-eval harness and a concordance gate: require concordance >= 0.98 on long-doc slice after warmup to clear the slice-hold.

ben: Add a 45m cooldown before any automatic re-promote of the same candidate to avoid flip-flop.

infra-bot: Created draft PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rollouts/pull/2002 - contains rollout-config, slice predicates, and exclusion filter. CI will run lint and validate metric hooks.

omar: Action items: sophia adds warmed-eval + concordance check; leah updates telemetry & weighting; ben implements cooldown; infra converts PR to rollout. If no objections, we run A/B+canary at 02:00 UTC.

leah: Fine by me, ping when infra PR is merged.

ben: ack.

sophia: will post warmed-eval results here about 40m after I start.

omar: Moving forward unless someone objects within the hour.
